equipment.name: Arduino Starter Kit
equipment.shortPurpose: Build quick circuits, sensor prototypes, and LED or motor projects.
equipment.description: Complete Arduino Uno starter box with breadboard, jumper wires, sensors, servos, and USB cable for class projects and prototypes.
equipment.specsPreview: Arduino Uno R3 • Breadboard • 20+ Sensors & Motors

guidelines.title: Check Polarity
guidelines.detail: Double-check 5V and GND wires before plugging in the USB cable.

guidelines.title: Pack All Parts
guidelines.detail: Place resistors, jumpers, and boards back into the organizer tray after use.

equipment.name: ESP32 Board
equipment.shortPurpose: Create wireless Wi-Fi and Bluetooth IoT projects with fast microcontrollers.
equipment.description: Dual-core Wi-Fi & Bluetooth microcontroller dev board mounted on an easy-access breakout with USB-C.

guidelines.title: 3.3V Pin Limit
guidelines.detail: Never connect 5V sensors directly to ESP32 signal pins without a level shifter.

equipment.name: Digital Oscilloscope
equipment.shortPurpose: See voltage signals, waves, and circuit timing live on a color screen.
equipment.description: 4-channel benchtop digital oscilloscope for debugging Arduino/ESP32 signals, audio circuits, and sensor pulses.
equipment.specsPreview: 100 MHz • 4 Analog Channels • Built-in Signal Check

guidelines.title: Ground Clip Safety
guidelines.detail: Connect probe ground clips only to circuit ground to avoid short circuits.

equipment.name: 3D Printer
equipment.shortPurpose: Print custom plastic parts, robot brackets, and project cases from CAD files.
equipment.description: Fast auto-leveling desktop 3D printer supporting PLA and PETG filaments for rapid student prototypes.
equipment.specsPreview: 250 × 210 × 210 mm • PLA & PETG • Auto Bed Level

guidelines.title: Watch First Layer
guidelines.detail: Stay for the first 5 minutes of your print to confirm the first layer sticks cleanly.

equipment.name: Laser Cutter
equipment.shortPurpose: Cut and engrave clean shapes into wood, acrylic sheets, and cardboard.
equipment.description: Enclosed CO2 laser cutter with exhaust fan for fast, accurate panels, robot chassis plates, and engravings.
equipment.specsPreview: 600 × 400 mm Bed • Wood & Acrylic • Exhaust Filtered

guidelines.title: Approved Materials Only
guidelines.detail: Never cut PVC or vinyl. Stay beside the machine at all times while cutting.

equipment.name: CNC Machine
equipment.shortPurpose: Carve solid aluminum, wood, or PCB boards using computer-guided cutting tools.
equipment.description: 3-axis desktop & shop CNC router for accurate mechanical brackets, enclosures, and milled parts.

guidelines.title: Dry Run First
guidelines.detail: Check tool height and run an air pass before cutting solid stock.

equipment.name: Robotic Arm
equipment.shortPurpose: Program pick-and-place movements, gripper tasks, and ROS motion paths.
equipment.description: 6-axis tabletop collaborative robotic arm with Python/ROS support and soft adaptive gripper.

guidelines.title: Keep E-Stop Close
guidelines.detail: Keep the red emergency stop button within reach while testing new robot code.

equipment.name: Mobile Robot Kit
equipment.shortPurpose: Test self-driving navigation, LiDAR mapping, and obstacle avoidance.
equipment.description: Wheeled autonomous robot platform equipped with 2D LiDAR scanner, depth camera, and onboard computer.
equipment.specsPreview: 2D LiDAR • Depth Camera • ROS Navigation Ready

guidelines.title: Floor Arena Only
guidelines.detail: Test autonomous driving inside the padded floor mat area in Room 204.

equipment.name: Line Follower Kit
equipment.shortPurpose: Learn PID speed control and IR sensor tracking on a campus test track.
equipment.description: Beginner-friendly robot car kit with 5-channel IR array, geared DC motors, and rechargeable battery pack.
equipment.specsPreview: 5-Sensor IR Array • Arduino Compatible • Practice Track

guidelines.title: Recharge After Use
guidelines.detail: Switch off the battery pack and plug it into the charging dock when finished.

equipment.name: Engineering PC
equipment.shortPurpose: Run CAD modeling, MATLAB simulations, PCB layout, and engineering software.
equipment.description: High-memory dual-monitor desktop workstation preloaded with SolidWorks, Fusion 360, MATLAB, KiCad, and VS Code.
equipment.specsPreview: 64GB RAM • Dual 27" Displays • CAD & MATLAB Installed

guidelines.title: Save to Cloud Drive
guidelines.detail: Save project files to your student cloud folder before signing out.

equipment.name: GPU Workstation
equipment.shortPurpose: Train machine learning models, computer vision tools, and 3D renders fast.
equipment.description: Dedicated deep learning tower with dual high-VRAM GPUs, CUDA toolkit, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
equipment.specsPreview: Dual High-VRAM GPUs • 128GB RAM • PyTorch & CUDA

guidelines.title: Save Checkpoints
guidelines.detail: Save training weights regularly so long jobs stay safe if time expires.

equipment.name: VR Headset
equipment.shortPurpose: Test virtual 3D spaces, Unity/Unreal apps, and interactive simulations.
equipment.description: Standalone & PC-tethered virtual reality headset with hand controllers and dedicated playspace mat.
equipment.specsPreview: 4K Per-Eye • Hand Tracking • Unity & Unreal Ready

guidelines.title: Wipe Foam Pad
guidelines.detail: Use the provided sanitizer wipes on the face cushion after each session.

equipment.name: Digital Multimeter
equipment.shortPurpose: Measure voltage, current, resistance, and check circuit connections safely.
equipment.description: True-RMS bench & handheld digital multimeter with backlit screen, continuity beep, and fused current inputs.
equipment.specsPreview: True-RMS • Voltage, Current, Ohms • Continuity Beep

guidelines.title: Check Probe Jacks
guidelines.detail: Move the red lead back to the V/Ω jack after measuring current to protect fuses.

equipment.name: Digital Vernier Caliper
equipment.shortPurpose: Measure small part sizes, hole diameters, and thicknesses down to 0.01 mm.
equipment.description: Stainless steel digital sliding caliper with instant millimeter/inch toggle and zero reset button.
equipment.specsPreview: 0–150 mm Range • ±0.02 mm Accuracy • mm / inch Switch

guidelines.title: Zero Before Measuring
guidelines.detail: Close the jaws gently and press Zero before taking part measurements.

equipment.name: Power Supply
equipment.shortPurpose: Give steady, adjustable DC voltage and current limits to your circuits.
equipment.description: Triple-output programmable DC bench power supply with current limiting to protect breadboards from shorts.

guidelines.title: Set Current Limit First
guidelines.detail: Set your voltage and current limit before pressing the Output On button.

equipment.name: Lathe Machine
equipment.shortPurpose: Spin and shape smooth round metal rods, shafts, threads, and bushings.
equipment.description: Precision benchtop metal lathe with variable spindle speed, digital readout, and safety chuck guard.
equipment.specsPreview: Variable RPM • Digital Readout • Safety Chuck Shield

guidelines.title: Remove Chuck Key
guidelines.detail: Never leave the chuck key inside the chuck. Tie back hair and wear safety glasses.

equipment.name: Milling Machine
equipment.shortPurpose: Cut flat surfaces, slots, and precise holes into aluminum or steel blocks.
equipment.description: Vertical manual & DRO knee milling machine for heavy-duty brackets, slotted mounts, and flat stock.

guidelines.title: Lock Unused Axes
guidelines.detail: Clamp your workpiece tightly in the vise and lock idle table axes before cutting.

equipment.name: Drill Press
equipment.shortPurpose: Drill straight, accurate holes in wood, plastic plates, and metal parts.
equipment.description: Floor-standing variable-speed drill press with laser center guide, depth stop, and table vise.

guidelines.title: Always Clamp Parts
guidelines.detail: Never hold small metal or plastic parts by hand while drilling—always use a clamp.

projects.title: Smart Weather Sensor Node
projects.description: Build and test a solar-powered temperature and air sensor node using ESP32 and Arduino.
projects.aiAnalysisSummary: Great fit for ESP32 Board, Digital Oscilloscope, and Power Supply testing.

projects.title: Campus Delivery Robot
projects.description: 3D-print custom sensor mounts and test autonomous navigation on the studio floor.
projects.aiAnalysisSummary: Use 3D Printer for brackets and Mobile Robot Kit for LiDAR path testing.

projects.title: Lightweight Arm Gripper
projects.description: Machine aluminum links and verify tolerances with digital calipers before assembly.
projects.aiAnalysisSummary: Pair CNC Machine cutting with Digital Vernier Caliper checks.
